name: browser-fetch-bridge
description: API-first endpoint adapters through an authenticated Chrome bridge.

interface.shortDescription: Run registered APIs through a local Chrome bridge.
interface.longDescription: Browser Fetch Bridge exposes registered endpoint adapters through one local CLI and detached daemon. The Chrome extension supplies authenticated fetch context. Workflow Skills are installed separately in the user's ~/.agents/skills directory.
defaultPrompt: Call a registered API through my logged-in Chrome session
